approved_translation: Cleverness and presence of mind can save you from danger; think before you act.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: A monkey lived in a great tree on a river bank. A Crocodile watched the Monkeys for a long time, and one day she said to her son: "My son, get one of those Monkeys for me. You know no fear. I'll let you alone after this." "Thank you, Crocodile, but I shall be on the watch for you just the same," said the Monkey.
